title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
summary: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
summary: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

title: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now
summary: In a detailed technical post, the exchange argued Bitcoin’s multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography must begin before any “Q-Day,” laying out requirements spanning block space, custody and dormant coins.

title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
summary: September CPI hit 3.7%, above forecasts, sending Treasury yields higher and dragging crypto down with stocks.

title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
summary: Turkish police and intelligence officers reportedly seized cash, phones, jewelry and firearms at the crypto founder's address in Beşiktaş.

title: Notorious Crypto Celeb Meme Coin Promoter Plots Second Wave on New Launchpad
summary: Sahil Arora says he's not done with celebrity meme coins, and that Fomo presents new possible strategies for his controversial schemes.

title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
summary: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.

title: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives
summary: The claim challenges 1,053 loss-making perpetual swap trades from 2018 to 2022 and also accuses the now-closed exchange of deceit.

title: Binance Is Shutting Down Its Bitcoin Mining Pool After Six Years
summary: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, and other related services in a retreat from mining infrastructure.

title: Bitcoin Whale That Sat Through Every Crash Since 2020 Just Moved $377M
summary: A wallet that received 4,581 BTC in March 2020, worth about $40 million then, moved its stash today when it was worth about $377 million.

title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
summary: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.

summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 before buyers stepped in, but the Fear and Greed Index says traders aren't convinced yet.

title: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
summary: Trezor is ending reseller authorizations on January 1, 2027, after Ledger confirmed that wallets sold by a Southeast Asian retailer carried a hidden implant that sent out users' recovery phrases.

summary: Crypto majors are red, alts are down bad and onchain is facing capitulation. This was not the ‘Uptober’ that was promised…

summary: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
summary: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.

title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
summary: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.
